messages.subject: EvaTrol 300 defrost thing
messages.body:
Dana,

Been reading tech bulletins tonight because the Harbor reset didn't stick. EvaTrol has a bulletin (TB-0912) for the 300 series: firmware 2.1 sometimes misses the defrost termination signal and the controller just sits in defrost-wait. Coil never clears and you get ice. Fix is firmware 2.3, flashed from a USB stick, about 15 min per controller, no parts.

I downloaded it onto a stick already. Harbor's unit is on 2.1. I'd guess any 300 from the spring batch we installed is on 2.1 too.

Marcus
